name: Topiary Beast
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-12: Mischief in the Maze

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Cobra Form Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity (Boar Form Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

offensiveAbilities.name: Functional Form
offensiveAbilities.description:
Depending on the creature it resembles, the topiary beast gains additional abilities.

Ape The branch Strike is agile, has reach 10 feet, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of piercing damage.

Boar The topiary beast gains the Ferocity reaction.

Cobra The beast gains the Attack of Opportunity reaction.

offensiveAbilities.name: Intimidating Display
offensiveAbilities.description: When using Intimidation to Demoralize a target, a topiary beast doesn't take a penalty for not speaking the same language as the target.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Crafting or Nature, DC 15
